decisions.summary: One counting helper scripts/_brief_load.py: exempt kind from the page-load line; counts only the assignment lists; sections, ranges expanded against real fragments, id-only lines one per id and at least one; page names derived from the record.
decisions.why: FR-001's helper as the spec's User Story 1 describes it; its heuristics err toward over-counting, which tightens the cap.

decisions.summary: Runner refuses at launch (exit 2) and STOPS the queue on a then:-printed brief; WRITE_CAP_OK with a two-word reason, guard-logged.
decisions.why: Spec Edge Cases and FR-001 as written.

decisions.summary: Continuation: L7R_PAGE_SESSION / L7R_CONTINUE per session; a left continue.md queued next, counted, before the group's then: checks, appending to the same handoff.

make reserve records the session on every ledger row; the runner exports L7R_KEY_CAP=10 only to a brief with no exempt kind and its continuations; with it set, the 11th registry key is refused with the continuation instruction; KEY_CAP_OK escape, guard-logged; glossary uncapped.
decisions.why: Round-1 finding resolved: the key cap now reaches write sessions only, matching suggestion 1 ('Cap a write session at ... 10 new registry keys') and the spec's 'a check session is not capped'.

decisions.summary: scripts/_coord.py: lines prints matching lines numbered, at most 80, then '(n of total lines shown)' and '(m more matched - narrow KEY)' when the cut drops matches; append creates the file if needed and prints only 'appended to <file>'.
decisions.why: FR-002 as written ('with a count of the rest'); the new cut notice makes a truncated answer visible, which serves suggestion 2 and narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: Slim rules file appended by the runner's floor_flags after the standing authorizations in one --append-system-prompt (moved from page-session.sh); the clone's root CLAUDE.md excluded; research CLAUDE.md still loads; drift test over House style and Research bullets.
decisions.why: FR-003 and its Edge Case; moving the append into floor_flags is placement, and makes SC-003's tested flags the launched flags.

decisions.summary: brief.py declares assertions on page briefs, check on 2a/2b and owed-modal briefs, split on split briefs; tested.
decisions.why: Spec Edge Cases and FR-001 verbatim.

decisions.summary: Docs: research CLAUDE.md, research-record-rules.md and the root CLAUDE.md's research bullet state both limits, the continuation, the page-load line with its four exempt kinds, and the read-by-line rule, with R1's figures.
decisions.why: Round-1 finding resolved: FR-001's 'both limits and the load line' and FR-002's read-only-this-way rule are now all named; the root CLAUDE.md addition informs the brief-generating sessions (FR-001, FR-005).

decisions.summary: Probe: one trivial headless session under the old flags and one under the new, first-turn input tokens recorded as research.md R2; cost stated before launch.
The owed post-landing measurement in future-work/cross-cutting.md with measure/'s scripts and R1's baseline.
After the landing is on main, the session 'Diagram supplemental' messages each research session with what changed and what their generators may now hit, recorded in the peer log.
decisions.why: FR-005 and the request's last sentence.
